pairs: In vigesimo quinto anno transmigrationis nostræ,
In the twenty-fifth year of our transmigration,
in exordio anni,
at the beginning of the year,
decima mensis,
on the tenth of the month,
quartodecimo anno postquam percussa est civitas,
in the fourteenth year after the city was struck,
in ipsa hac die,
on this very day,
facta est super me manus Domini,
the hand of the Lord was placed upon me,
et adduxit me illuc.
and he brought me to that place.
In visionibus Dei adduxit me in terram Israël,
In the visions of God, he brought me into the land of Israel,
et dimisit me super montem excelsum nimis,
and he released me on an exceedingly high mountain,
super quem erat quasi ædificium civitatis vergentis ad austrum.
on which there was something like the edifice of a city, verging toward the south.
Et introduxit me illuc:
And he led me into that place.
et ecce vir cujus erat species quasi species æris,
And behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass,
et funiculus lineus in manu ejus,
with a linen rope in his hand,
et calamus mensuræ in manu ejus:
and a measuring reed in his hand.
stabat autem in porta.
And he was standing at the gate.
Et locutus est ad me idem vir:
And the same man said to me: “Son of man,
Fili hominis,
look with your eyes,
vide oculis tuis,
and listen with your ears,
et auribus tuis audi, et pone cor tuum in omnia quæ ego ostendam tibi,
and set your heart upon all that I will reveal to you. For you have been brought to this place,
quia ut ostendantur tibi adductus es huc.
so that these things may be revealed to you.
Annuntia omnia quæ tu vides domui Israël.
Announce all that you see to the house of Israel.”
Et ecce murus forinsecus in circuitu domus undique:
And behold, there was a wall outside of the house, encircling it all around,
et in manu viri calamus mensuræ sex cubitorum et palmo:
and in the man’s hand was a measuring reed of six cubits and a palm.
et mensus est latitudinem ædificii calamo uno,
And he measured the width of the edifice with one reed;
altitudinem quoque calamo uno.
likewise, the height with one reed.
Et venit ad portam quæ respiciebat viam orientalem,
And he went to the gate which looked toward the east,
et ascendit per gradus ejus:
and he ascended by its steps.
et mensus est limen portæ calamo uno latitudinem,
And he measured the width of the threshold of the gate as one reed,
id est,
that is,
limen unum calamo uno in latitudine.
one threshold was one reed in width.
Et thalamum uno calamo in longum,
And a chamber was one reed in length
et uno calamo in latum:
and one reed in width.
et inter thalamos,
And between the chambers,
quinque cubitos.
there were five cubits.
Et limen portæ,
And the threshold of the gate,
juxta vestibulum portæ intrinsecus,
next to the inner vestibule of the gate,
calamo uno.
was one reed.
Et mensus est vestibulum portæ octo cubitorum,
And he measured the vestibule of the gate as eight cubits,
et frontem ejus duobus cubitis:
and its front as two cubits.
vestibulum autem portæ erat intrinsecus.
But the vestibule of the gate was inside.
Porro thalami portæ ad viam orientalem,
Moreover, the chambers of the gate, toward the way of the east,
tres hinc et tres inde:
were three from one side to the other.
mensura una trium,
The three were of one measure,
et mensura una frontium ex utraque parte.
and the fronts were of one measure, on both sides.
Et mensus est latitudinem liminis portæ decem cubitorum,
And he measured the width of the threshold of the gate as ten cubits,
et longitudinem portæ tredecim cubitorum.
and the length of the gate as thirteen cubits.
Et marginem ante thalamos, cubiti unius,
And before the chambers, the border was one cubit.
et cubitus unus finis utrimque:
And on both sides, the border was one cubit.
thalami autem sex cubitorum erant hinc et inde.
But the chambers were six cubits, from one side to the other.
Et mensus est portam a tecto thalami usque ad tectum ejus,
And he measured the gate, from the roof of one chamber to the roof of another,
latitudinem viginti quinque cubitorum,
twenty-five cubits in width,
ostium contra ostium.
from door to door.
Et fecit frontes per sexaginta cubitos,
And he found the fronts to be sixty cubits. And at the front,
et ad frontem atrium portæ undique per circuitum.
there was a court for the gate on every side all around.
Et ante faciem portæ quæ pertingebat usque ad faciem vestibuli portæ interioris,
And before the face of the gate, which extended even to the face of the vestibule of the gate of the interior,
quinquaginta cubitos.
there were fifty cubits.
Et fenestras obliquas in thalamis et in frontibus eorum,
And there were slanting windows in the chambers and at their fronts,
quæ erant intra portam undique per circuitum:
which were within the gate on every side all around.
similiter autem erant et in vestibulis fenestræ per gyrum intrinsecus,
And similarly, there were also windows in the vestibules all around the interior,
et ante frontes pictura palmarum.
and there were images of palm trees before the fronts.
Et eduxit me ad atrium exterius:
And he led me away to the outer court,
et ecce gazophylacia,
and behold,
et pavimentum stratum lapide in atrio per circuitum:
there were storerooms and a layer of pavement stones throughout the court.
triginta gazophylacia in circuitu pavimenti.
Thirty storerooms encircled the pavement.
Et pavimentum in fronte portarum,
And the pavement in front of the gates,
secundum longitudinem portarum erat inferius.
along the length of the gates, was lower.
Et mensus est latitudinem a facie portæ inferioris usque ad frontem atrii interioris extrinsecus:
And he measured the width, from the face of the lower gate to the front of the outer part of the inner court,
centum cubitos ad orientem et ad aquilonem.
to be one hundred cubits, to the east and to the north.
Portam quoque quæ respiciebat viam aquilonis atrii exterioris,
Likewise, he measured the gate of the outer court,
mensus est tam in longitudine quam in latitudine.
which looked to the way of the north, to be as much in length as in width.
Et thalamos ejus tres hinc et tres inde,
And its chambers were three from one side to the other.
et frontem ejus et vestibulum ejus secundum mensuram portæ prioris,
And its front and its vestibule,
quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinem ejus,
in accord with the measure of the former gate,
et latitudinem viginti quinque cubitorum.
were fifty cubits in its length and twenty-five cubits in width.
Fenestræ autem ejus,
Now its windows,
et vestibulum,
and the vestibule,
et sculpturæ secundum mensuram portæ quæ respiciebat ad orientem:
and the engravings were in accord with the measure of the gate which looked to the east.
et septem graduum erat ascensus ejus,
And its ascent was by seven steps,
et vestibulum ante eam.
and a vestibule was before it.
Et porta atrii interioris contra portam aquilonis
And the gate of the inner court was opposite the gate of the north,
et orientalem:
and that of the east.
et mensus est a porta usque ad portam centum cubitos.
And he measured from gate to gate as one hundred cubits.
Et eduxit me ad viam australem:
And he led me to the way of the south,
et ecce porta quæ respiciebat ad austrum:
and behold,
et mensus est frontem ejus
there was a gate which looked toward the south.
et vestibulum ejus juxta mensuras superiores.
And he measured its front and its vestibule to be the same as the measures above.
Et fenestras ejus, et vestibula in circuitu, sicut fenestras ceteras:
And its windows and the vestibule all around were like the other windows:
quinquaginta cubitorum longitudine, et latitudine viginti quinque cubitorum.
fifty cubits in length and twenty-five cubits in width.
Et in gradibus septem ascendebatur ad eam,
And there were seven steps to ascend to it,
et vestibulum ante fores ejus:
and a vestibule before its doors.
et cælatæ palmæ erant, una hinc,
And there were engraved palm trees,
et altera inde,
one on each side,
in fronte ejus.
at its front.
Et porta atrii interioris in via australi:
And there was a gate at the inner court, on the way to the south.
et mensus est a porta usque ad portam in via australi,
And he measured from one gate to another, on the way to the south,
centum cubitos.
to be one hundred cubits.
Et introduxit me in atrium interius ad portam australem:
And he led me into the inner court, to the south gate.
et mensus est portam juxta mensuras superiores.
And he measured the gate to be in accord with the measures above.
Thalamum ejus,
Its chamber,
et frontem ejus,
and its front,
et vestibulum ejus eisdem mensuris,
and its vestibule had the same measures.
et fenestras ejus, et vestibulum ejus in circuitu, quinquaginta cubitos longitudinis,
And its windows and its vestibule all around were fifty cubits in length,
et latitudinis viginti quinque cubitos.
and twenty-five cubits in width.
Et vestibulum per gyrum longitudine viginti quinque cubitorum,
And the vestibule all around was twenty-five cubits in length,
et latitudine quinque cubitorum:
and five cubits in width.
et vestibulum ejus ad atrium exterius,
And its vestibule was toward the outer court,
et palmas ejus in fronte:
and its palm trees were at the front.
et octo gradus erant quibus ascendebatur per eam.
And there were eight steps to ascend to it.
Et introduxit me in atrium interius,
And he led me into the inner court,
per viam orientalem:
along the way of the east.
et mensus est portam secundum mensuras superiores.
And he measured the gate to be in accord with the measures above.
Thalamum ejus,
Its chamber,
et frontem ejus,
and its front,
et vestibulum ejus, sicut supra:
and its vestibule were as above.
et fenestras ejus, et vestibula ejus in circuitu, longitudine quinquaginta cubitorum,
And its windows and its vestibules all around were fifty cubits in length,
et latitudine viginti quinque cubitorum.
and twenty-five cubits in width.
Et vestibulum ejus,
And it had a vestibule,
id est,
that is,
atrii exterioris,
at the outer court.
et palmæ cælatæ in fronte ejus,
And the engraved palm trees at its front were on one side
hinc et inde:
and the other.
et in octo gradibus ascensus ejus.
And its ascent was by eight steps.
Et introduxit me ad portam quæ respiciebat ad aquilonem:
And he led me to the gate which looked toward the north.
et mensus est secundum mensuras superiores.
And he measured it to be in accord with the measures above.
Thalamum ejus,
Its chamber,
et frontem ejus,
and its front,
et vestibulum ejus,
and its vestibule,
et fenestras ejus per circuitum, longitudine quinquaginta cubitorum,
and its windows all around were fifty cubits in length,
et latitudine viginti quinque cubitorum.
and twenty-five cubits in width.
Et vestibulum ejus respiciebat ad atrium exterius:
And its vestibule looked toward the outer court.
et cælatura palmarum in fronte ejus,
And an engraving of palm trees at its front was on one side
hinc et inde:
and the other.
et in octo gradibus ascensus ejus.
And its ascent was by eight steps.
Et per singula gazophylacia ostium in frontibus portarum:
And at each one of the storerooms, there was a door at the front of the gates.
ibi lavabant holocaustum.
There, they washed the holocaust.
Et in vestibulo portæ,
And at the vestibule of the gate,
duæ mensæ hinc,
there were two tables on one side,
et duæ mensæ inde,
and two tables on the other side,
ut immoletur super eas holocaustum,
so that the holocaust,
et pro peccato
and the offering for sin,
et pro delicto.
and the offering for transgression could be immolated upon them.
Et ad latus exterius,
And at the outer side,
quod ascendit ad ostium portæ quæ pergit ad aquilonem,
which ascends to the door of the gate that goes toward the north,
duæ mensæ:
there were two tables.
et ad latus alterum,
And at the other side,
ante vestibulum portæ,
before the vestibule of the gate,
duæ mensæ:
there were two tables.
quatuor mensæ hinc,
Four tables were on one side,
et quatuor mensæ inde:
and four tables were on the other side;
per latera portæ octo mensæ erant,
along the sides of the gate, there were eight tables,
super quas immolabant.
upon which they immolated.
Quatuor autem mensæ ad holocaustum de lapidibus quadris exstructæ,
Now the four tables for the holocausts were constructed of square stones:
longitudine cubiti unius et dimidii,
one and a half cubit in length,
et latitudine cubiti unius et dimidii,
and one and a half cubits in width,
et altitudine cubiti unius:
and one cubit in height. Upon these,
super quas ponant vasa in quibus immolatur holocaustum et victima.
they placed the vessels, in which the holocaust and the victim were immolated.
Et labia earum palmi unius,
And their edges were one palm in width,
reflexa intrinsecus per circuitum:
turned inward all around.
super mensas autem carnes oblationis.
And the flesh of the oblation was on the tables.
Et extra portam interiorem,
And outside the interior gate,
gazophylacia cantorum in atrio interiori,
there were storerooms for the cantors, in the inner court,
quod erat in latere portæ respicientis ad aquilonem:
which was beside the gate that looks toward the north.
et facies eorum contra viam australem:
And their face was opposite the way to the south;
una ex latere portæ orientalis,
one was beside the east gate,
quæ respiciebat ad viam aquilonis.
which looked toward the way of the north.
Et dixit ad me:
And he said to me:
Hoc est gazophylacium quod respicit viam meridianam:
“This is the storeroom that looks toward the south;
sacerdotum erit, qui excubant in custodiis templi.
it shall be for the priests who keep watch for the protection of the temple.
Porro gazophylacium quod respicit ad viam aquilonis,
Moreover,
sacerdotum erit,
the storeroom that looks toward the north will be for the priests who keep watch over the ministry of the altar.
qui excubant ad ministerium altaris:
These are the sons of Zadok,
isti sunt filii Sadoc,
those among the sons of Levi who may draw near to the Lord,
qui accedunt de filiis Levi ad Dominum ut ministrent ei.
so that they may minister to him.”
Et mensus est atrium longitudine centum cubitorum,
And he measured the court to be one hundred cubits in length,
et latitudine centum cubitorum per quadrum:
and one hundred cubits in width, with four equal sides.
et altare ante faciem templi.
And the altar was before the face of the temple.
Et introduxit me in vestibulum templi:
And he led me into the vestibule of the temple.
et mensus est vestibulum quinque cubitis hinc,
And he measured the vestibule to be five cubits on one side,
et quinque cubitis inde:
and five cubits on the other side.
et latitudinem portæ trium cubitorum hinc,
And the width of the gate was three cubits on one side,
et trium cubitorum inde.
and three cubits on the other side.
Longitudinem autem vestibuli viginti cubitorum,
Now the length of the vestibule was twenty cubits,
et latitudinem undecim cubitorum,
and the width was eleven cubits,
et octo gradibus ascendebatur ad eam.
and there were eight steps to ascend to it.
Et columnæ erant in frontibus:
And there were pillars at the front,
una hinc,
one on this side
et altera inde.
and another on that side.
